name: prover-typescript
description: A tiny Curry–Howard proof assistant kernel in TypeScript

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js dist/tests/kernel/*.test.js dist/tests/elaborator/*.test.js dist/tests/parser/*.test.js
